method.primary_selection: Minimum two-view mask loss after a hard requirement that oriented visible area, length and width all lie inside the object's D-0018 p10–p90 ranges.
method.sensitivity_selection: Minimum of the legacy soft dimension-penalty loss over all candidates, retained to expose selection-size failures.
method.loss: 1 - mean(true-colour IoU, PCA IoU) + 0.2 × mean(log distance outside the dimension intervals); lower is better.
method.geometry: Principal-axis-normalised, reflection-invariant binary masks; candidate dimensions are recomputed as oriented extents at 0.5 m per pixel for all families.
method.equal_budget: 3372 masks in each of five combined families for every object.
method.nonwing_allocation: 562 each of horizontal stabiliser, nacelle plan, nacelle side, rudder-region polygon, vertical tail and elevator-region polygon.
method.ocean_allocation: 562 each of six D-0034 ocean-object classes.
method.interpretation: Best-of-search descriptive control. Not a class likelihood, likelihood ratio, Bayes factor, posterior identity probability or prevalence estimate.
